reading.title: The thigh and knee
reading.text: Dina reads a lower-body guide. Thigh is between hip and knee. Quadricep is an everyday form of the quadriceps muscle name. Hamstring can refer to muscles or their tendons at the back of the thigh. Dina learns hip joint, groin, femur, knee, kneecap and shin. She uses the names to describe locations in a model, not to judge pain or choose an exercise treatment.
